title: Standardize development and CI on PostgreSQL 15
translation_policy: Faithful English translation of the original Japanese prompt and visible AI interaction used during development. No summary, beautification, or added requirements. Code, commands, file paths, URLs, identifiers, and error messages are kept in their original form.
notes: pr_number and pr_url are backfilled in a follow-up commit on this branch once the PR is opened. merge_commit / ci_status / post_merge_ci_status remain null in the shipped record and are always verifiable via the linked pr_url.
